question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Recent pattern: NVDA beats its guide midpoint by ~4.6-5.7% (Q1 FY27 78.0->81.6; Q2 91.0->96.2) and guides the next quarter ~11.5-12.3% above the just-reported actual. Q3 guide $108B implies Q3 actual ~$112-115B (consensus $108.8B; thin Polymarket Q3 DC >$105B ~53% consistent with ~$113B total). Applying an 11-13% uplift gives a Q4 guide of ~$124-130B. Upside: Vera Rubin ramp (shipments began Aug), FY28 70% growth forecast, supply commitments up to $279B, Q4 gross margin trough at 71-72% signalling a heavy Rubin mix. Downside: memory/supply constraints, China excluded, conservative guiding. No market matches this question; the Polymarket Q3 DC revenue ladders are thin and internally inconsistent.

- Resolves off the midpoint in the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release (Nov 17 2026), rounded to the nearest $1B; not off actual Q4 revenue or the call commentary.
